newsitem.title: USA: Devon, Kerr-McGee unit complete merger.
newsitem.headline: Devon, Kerr-McGee unit complete merger.

text.p: Devon Energy Corp and Kerr-McGee Corp said on Tuesday they have completed the merger of Kerr-McGee's North American onshore oil and gas exploration and production businesses into Devon.
The deal is valued at approximately $347 million, based upon Devon's 34-7/8 stock price and approximately 9.95 million shares to be issued to Kerr McGee.
The two companies first announced the deal in October and Devon shareholders approved it earlier this month, the companies said.

The properties contributed to Devon had estimated proved oil and gas reserves of 61 million barrels of oil equivalent as of year-end 1995 and 370,000 net acres of land with undeveloped drilling rights, the companies said.
The companies said the deal adds to Devon's proved reserves by 50 percent.
Kerr-McGee received 9,954,000 newly issued Devon common shares, which is about a 31 percent stake, and gets three seats on Devon's board, the companies said. Devon now has nine directors total.
